template.description: Acme Payments storefront API, payments worker, admin portal and config server, on one UAT server.

uat.label: Shopfront UAT
uat.notes:
Ubuntu 22.04 with Java 21 (Temurin). Every app runs as deploy from its own folder under /opt/acme.
git on the server is 2.34; the config repo is the only git repo there.
Every stop.sh kills its app by port, so give a stop up to 30 seconds before starting again.
The server's default git identity is a shared bot account, so config commits pass the deployer's name and email.

apps.name: storefront-api
apps.instructions:
It talks to the payments sandbox only. Never point any of its URLs at a live payment gateway.
Its start script truncates the log with > on every start, so read the log right after a failed start.

apps.name: payments-worker
apps.instructions:
Built from the same repo as storefront-api.
Its start script spreads the java command over several lines, so the jar name is replaced in place.

apps.name: admin-portal
apps.instructions: start.sh runs current.jar, a symlink into releases/, so a deploy only moves the link.

apps.name: config-server
apps.instructions:
Spring Cloud Config Server for storefront-api and payments-worker. It serves the git repo /opt/acme/config-repo
and reads it only at startup, so restart it after every config commit, then restart the app.

template.instructions:
An app reads its config only at startup: after a config commit, restart the config server first, then the app.
Start and stop scripts live in each app's folder; never start an app any other way.
UAT shares the payments sandbox with the QA team: say in the team channel before restarting payments-worker.

file_text:
# UAT template for the uat-deploy skill. Edit it from /uat-deploy (Edit template) or by hand,
# then check it with: uat template-check shopfront
schema: 1
id: shopfront
name: Shopfront
description: Acme Payments storefront API, payments worker, admin portal and config server, on one UAT server.
servers:
  uat:
    label: Shopfront UAT
    host: 203.0.113.10
    user: deploy
    aliases:
      - shopfront-uat
    notes: |
      Ubuntu 22.04 with Java 21 (Temurin). Every app runs as deploy from its own folder under /opt/acme.
      git on the server is 2.34; the config repo is the only git repo there.
      Every stop.sh kills its app by port, so give a stop up to 30 seconds before starting again.
      The server's default git identity is a shared bot account, so config commits pass the deployer's name and email.
defaults:
  start_timeout: 180
  stop_timeout: 30
  ready:
    log: Started [A-Za-z0-9_$]+ in [0-9.]+ seconds
    fail: APPLICATION FAILED TO START
apps:
  - id: api
    name: storefront-api
    server: uat
    dir: /opt/acme/storefront-api
    port: 8080
    log: /opt/acme/logs/storefront-api/app.log
    start: ./start-api.sh
    stop: ./stop.sh
    build:
      repo: shopfront
      detect: storefront-api/pom.xml
      command: mvn clean package -DskipTests -pl storefront-api -am
      output: storefront-api/target/*.jar
    deploy:
      style: jar-start-script
      edit: duplicate
      name_prefix: api
    configs:
      - id: main
        path: /opt/acme/config-repo/storefront-api-uat.yml
        format: yaml
        git_repo: /opt/acme/config-repo
        served_by: config
        verify_url: http://localhost:8888/storefront-api-uat.yml?resolvePlaceholders=false
        restart:
          - config
          - api
    instructions: |
      It talks to the payments sandbox only. Never point any of its URLs at a live payment gateway.
      Its start script truncates the log with > on every start, so read the log right after a failed start.
  - id: payments
    name: payments-worker
    server: uat
    dir: /opt/acme/payments-worker
    port: 8082
    log: /opt/acme/logs/payments-worker/worker.log
    start: ./start-worker.sh
    stop: ./stop.sh
    build:
      repo: shopfront
      detect: payments-worker/pom.xml
      command: mvn clean package -DskipTests -pl payments-worker -am
      output: payments-worker/target/*.jar
    deploy:
      style: jar-start-script
      edit: replace
      name_prefix: worker
    configs:
      - id: main
        path: /opt/acme/config-repo/payments-worker-uat.yml
        format: yaml
        git_repo: /opt/acme/config-repo
        served_by: config
        verify_url: http://localhost:8888/payments-worker-uat.yml?resolvePlaceholders=false
        restart:
          - config
          - payments
    instructions: |
      Built from the same repo as storefront-api.
      Its start script spreads the java command over several lines, so the jar name is replaced in place.
  - id: admin
    name: admin-portal
    server: uat
    dir: /opt/acme/admin-portal
    port: 8090
    log: /opt/acme/logs/admin-portal/admin.log
    start: ./start.sh
    stop: ./stop.sh
    ready:
      url: http://localhost:8090/actuator/health
    build:
      repo: admin-portal
      detect: pom.xml
      command: ./mvnw clean package -DskipTests
      output: target/*.jar
    deploy:
      style: custom
      name_prefix: admin
      upload_dir: /opt/acme/admin-portal/releases
      steps:
        - ln -sfn releases/{new} current.jar
        - echo {new} >> releases/DEPLOYED
      rollback:
        - sed -i '$d' releases/DEPLOYED
        - ln -sfn releases/$(tail -n 1 releases/DEPLOYED) current.jar
    configs:
      - id: props
        path: /opt/acme/admin-portal/config/application-uat.properties
        format: properties
        restart:
          - admin
    instructions: start.sh runs current.jar, a symlink into releases/, so a deploy only moves the link.
  - id: config
    name: config-server
    server: uat
    dir: /opt/acme/config-server
    port: 8888
    log: /opt/acme/logs/config-server/config.log
    start: ./start.sh
    stop: ./stop.sh
    instructions: |
      Spring Cloud Config Server for storefront-api and payments-worker. It serves the git repo /opt/acme/config-repo
      and reads it only at startup, so restart it after every config commit, then restart the app.
instructions: |
  An app reads its config only at startup: after a config commit, restart the config server first, then the app.
  Start and stop scripts live in each app's folder; never start an app any other way.
  UAT shares the payments sandbox with the QA team: say in the team channel before restarting payments-worker.
